2027-02-18.limits: Top 16 and ties in every event (18 in the 300m and 600m). One relay team per school in the 4x200, 4x400 and 4x800, with a qualifying performance.
2027-02-18.deadline: 6:00pm, Monday, Feb 15, on Yen Timing. Entries are final at the deadline. The meet program is posted by Tuesday, Feb 16.
details: Athletes need a qualifying performance to enter an event.
Athletes may enter up to 3 individual events. An athlete entered in 3 individual events can't also run a relay. Otherwise, athletes may run any relay they're listed on, up to 3 events total.
Relay athletes and alternates must also be entered online. Alternates can be swapped only for circumstances beyond the athlete's control, with committee approval.
Athletes must have competed in 6 certified meets during the regular season to be eligible for sectionals.
Championship scratch rule: an athlete who scratches an event on meet day is done for the rest of the meet.
Team scoring: 10, 8, 6, 4, 2, 1.
Team awards: championship trophy, patches, medals and shirts for 1st; finalist shirts for 2nd. Individual: medal, patch and shirt for 1st; ribbons for 2nd–6th.
Each school is assigned a job to help run the meet.

Long jump, triple jump, shot put and weight throw: 3 attempts each, then the top 8 get 3 more in the finals.
2027-02-26.limits: Top 16 and ties in individual events (18 in the 300m and 600m). Top 6 per division in relays. Extra entries are accepted if they meet the state standard.
2027-02-26.deadline: 8:00pm, Monday, Feb 22, on Yen Timing. The performance list is in coach accounts by 9:00pm Monday.
details: Scratch window: 24 hours, closing 8:00pm Tuesday, Feb 23. Email scratches to coachyen@gmail.com, and get every athlete down to 3 events by then.
After the scratch deadline, an athlete who scratches an event is done for the day.
Relays run in 2 divisions by seed time: Division 1 for 600+ schools, Division 2 for 599 and smaller. Relay athletes (4–6) must also be entered online.
Athletes need a mark on the leaderboard in an event to be entered in it.
Athletes may enter up to 3 individual events. An athlete entered in 3 individual events can't also run a relay. Otherwise, athletes may run any relay they're listed on, up to 3 events total.
Athletes must have competed in 6 certified meets during the regular season to be eligible for sectionals.
The final program is posted after 9:00pm Tuesday, Feb 23.
The 3rd-place finishers in the 300m, 600m, 1000m and 1600m/1500m run the intersectional medley relay at states. If a 3rd-place finisher meets the state standard, the 4th-place finisher goes instead.

2027-01-16.venue: Golisano Training Center, Nazareth University, 4245 East Ave, Rochester
details: Selective meet: entries must meet the minimum marks and aren't guaranteed. Accepted entries are posted on LeoneTiming.com by noon Wednesday, Jan 13.
Per school: 2 athletes per track event, 1 relay, 2 per field event. More athletes are allowed if they meet the minimum marks.
Entries close 11:59pm Tuesday, Jan 12 on Athletic.net. Scratches to James Goss (jgoss2@naz.edu) by noon Friday, Jan 15.
Spikes: 1/4" pyramids only, checked at the turf before each event. Check in at least 15 minutes before your event. Bring no starting blocks.
Races other than the 55m and 55m hurdles are timed finals, fastest heats first. The meet is scored; top 3 in each event get podium recognition, and winners get a champion T-shirt.
Spectators: $5 for adults 18+, cash or Venmo; students and children are free. Results are live on LeoneTiming.com (not Yen Timing).
Times are tentative; a final schedule comes out after entries close.
